title: C rf_health: rebalance loss threshold 40% -> 25% (spec 02a 2a.8 R-02a-112)
description: Smallest child of b7z9.30. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.c:121 lichen_rf_health_should_rebalance uses packet_loss_rate_pct > 40; spec 02a 2a.8 and the 0.25 threshold pinned by ccp16_ema_loss_threshold.json (Rust rf_health.rs:446 uses > 0.25) require 25%. Change the C check to > 25 and add a unit test in the existing host CMake test target (routing_dispatch or a new tests/rf_health) pinning boundary 25%/26%. Note: parent's claim that C used 40% was confirmed still true at HEAD.
